subject: Woven
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently started working with Woven, and noticed that you collaborated with them during your PhD, so thought it could be interesting to explore if we can help at [COMPANY] in a similar way.

Woven's Vision team faced challenges with existing data curation & visualisation solutions (Voxel51 & internal tools), which lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets.

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through their datasets (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling Vision teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with Woven and similar partners in the space.

Would you be open to having a quick coffee chat later this week?
